newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP says Dec copper output up sharply.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP says Dec copper output up sharply.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Monday that its production of copper in concentrate rose 73 percent and copper cathodes and copper anodes were up 2,021 percent in the seven months ended December 31, compared with the same period a year earlier.
December production of copper concentrates was up 73 percent, while cathode and anode production gained 2,227 percent compared to the saame period a year earlier, the company said.
The rise reflected the phase three expansion of its 57.5 percent owned La Escondida mine in Chile and the acquisition of Magma Copper Co last January, BHP said.

Copper in concentrate output from the Ok Tedi mine in Papua New Guinea (PNG) improved in December from the year-ago level due to the mining of higher ore head grades BHP said in its December production report.
Shipments of copper concentrates from PNG rose in December over the year-earlier period due to higher output and improved weather conditions, the company said.
However, year-to-date PNG copper concentrate shipments were lower because of overall bad weather conditions over the period, the company said.

NOTE: December is the seventh month of BHP's financial year.
